queries.query: Bedrock InvokeModel is returning AccessDeniedException for claude-3-5-sonnet in us-east-1
queries.rationale: Named AI/ML service plus an access-denied error is the primary activation case.

queries.query: User: arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/app-role/session is not authorized to perform: bedrock:InvokeModel on resource: arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1::foundation-model/anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0
queries.rationale: Verbatim AWS denial string for an AI/ML action; the strongest activation signal.

queries.query: My SageMaker training job fails with AccessDenied and I cannot tell why
queries.rationale: SageMaker job creation failure with a permission error.

queries.query: is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/sagemaker-execution-role
queries.rationale: PassRole denial against a SageMaker execution role.

queries.query: Why can't my SageMaker execution role read from the training data bucket?
queries.rationale: Hop-4 downstream permission failure, phrased without the word AccessDenied.

queries.query: Review my IAM roles for least privilege and tell me which ones are too permissive
queries.rationale: Posture review with no failure to diagnose. This skill is reactive only; least-privilege auditing is a different task.

queries.query: Bedrock InvokeModel is returning ThrottlingException, how do I raise my quota?
queries.rationale: Bedrock error but a quota problem, not an access problem. Throttling is explicitly excluded because it is commonly mistaken for a permissions issue.

queries.query: My Lambda function gets AccessDenied writing to an S3 bucket
queries.rationale: Access-denied failure but no AI/ML service involved. Adjacent negative — the error class matches but the service scope does not.

queries.query: Write me an IAM policy that allows Bedrock model invocation
queries.rationale: Policy authoring with no failure. Adjacent negative — mentions Bedrock and IAM but there is nothing to diagnose.

queries.query: My Bedrock model responses are low quality and inconsistent, how do I improve them?
queries.rationale: Bedrock issue that is not access-related at all.

queries.query: Amazon Textract is returning AccessDenied when I call AnalyzeDocument
queries.rationale: AI/ML access failure in a service this version does not support. Closest adjacent negative — if the skill activates here it should report unsupported rather than diagnose generically, so either outcome must be checked deliberately during manual validation.

queries.query: My SageMaker endpoint has high p99 latency during peak traffic
queries.rationale: SageMaker operational issue unrelated to access.
